definitions.gloss: to offer; to propose; to volunteer; to apply
definitions.explanation: To formally put forward an offer, proposal, or request. Slightly formal in register.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}い→手伝い：02488_tetsudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}→申し出：13560_moushide⟧た。
⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{出|で}る⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of employees applying to resign is increasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}→遠慮：01337_enryo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}→申し出：13560_moushide⟧て⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If there are any problems, please don't hesitate to speak up.

notes:
{申|もう}し{出|で}る is a compound verb meaning to formally offer or propose something. It has a slightly formal tone.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{出|で}る

ASPECT (ている):
- ⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}→申し出：13560_moushide⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means "has offered / has made a request" (resulting state)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{出|で}る: to offer cooperation
- ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{出|で}る: to submit a resignation

The noun form is ⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}→申し出：13560_moushide⟧ (an offer; a proposal).
